hypothesis: Preserve the actual public research-source AP processor and build identity for one independently specified F05 128-case validation; prove source/binary/config/runtime identity and finite engineering transport without changing DSP or running real speech.

source.actual_execution_revision: Explicit --expected-head must be the clean checked-out 40-character publicly frozen research commit; do not label it as a main-built binary.

build.host: GitHub Actions Ubuntu 24.04 Linux x86_64 only; no local compiler execution
build.compiler: Installed GNU C compiler; resolve, hash, version and -dumpmachine recorded before/after. No compiler or package download.
build.relocation: Copy both binaries and full evidence, rename the original build directory, then run all engineering from the bundle. Reject absolute RPATH/RUNPATH and any dependency resolving into original build/source.
build.system_libraries: Do not redistribute libc/libm/loader. Record actual shared dependency name/resolved path/SHA, ELF identity and available system package license notices; a new host requires its own real engineering receipt.
build.first_party_license: Archive unmodified repository LICENSE with the source snapshot.

engineering.legacy_render_behavior: The unchanged CLI can zero-pad a short render. The engineering/scientific adapter rejects this before invocation; do not claim a CLI behavior change.
engineering.latency_authority: ap_pipeline_algorithmic_latency_ms: NS contributes AP_FRAME_MS=10; 16k-to-16k resampler contributes zero. Every trace row including first must equal 10ms. This is source-declared buffering metadata, not physical delay or HPF/BF phase calibration.
engineering.empty_case: Zero frames succeed with empty output/trace; no acoustic qualification is inferred.
output_checks: all consecutive frame indices starting zero
repeat output and trace byte identity
unchanged output/trace prefix despite changed future
binary and dependency SHA unchanged before/after
engineering.store: Every attempted command is written before launch; actual start/finish UTC, monotonic elapsed, exit/timeout, stdout/stderr, inputs, outputs, complete traces and hashes are preserved. Timeouts kill the process group; negative actual partial artifacts remain explicitly classified.

bundle.manifest: Complete relative path SHA256 map excludes only bundle.json itself; no duplicate paths, traversal, symlinks, hardlinks, special files, undeclared extra files or missing entries.
bundle.runtime_identity_helper: Reuse unchanged webrtc_aec3_ci.runtime_identity and record its exact committed source/dependency closure.
bundle.new_host: CI report remains preserved; engineering --bundle --output creates a new bounded actual report on Debian13 or another compatible Linux host. Read-only require_host_engineering compares current dependency names/hashes/host with the selected receipt, never copies CI host identity into a new host claim.

interfaces.verify_bundle: dict {manifest, build, engineering, paths}; paths contains resolved processor/build_info/build_receipt/engineering Path objects. No binary execution.
interfaces.require_host_engineering: dict {engineering, receipt, runtime_identity}; optional explicit receipt; validates actual runtime using read-only ldd and hashes. No DSP.
interfaces.verify_engineering: verify_engineering(root, receipt) -> validated engineering dict, read-only source/binary/report/trace/hash verification without current-host ldd or DSP. require_host_engineering additionally checks actual current runtime.
interfaces.bind_render_corr_native: Return stable JSON binding; load only the preserved native helper into the original canonical module. No compilation or SDK execution.
interfaces.build_bound_max_abs_corr: Return original exact_score guarded by owned native-state/library/source/runtime identity before and after each call; no cold-loader fallback.
interfaces.render_corr_runtime_identity: Return actual current ldd+parent map observation only; no implicit AP engineering rerun.

workflow.name: Frontend Research
workflow.aec3_selection_on_new_experiment: true when the actual base-to-head range introduces or changes registered AEC3 method/build/admission files; mandatory together with AP for initial c7-based mixed integration. An explicit AP-only manual dispatch is separate.
workflow.new_selector: New explicit integration scope validates actual complete workflow, exact reviewed c7 carryover bytes and declared AP/F05 additions before selecting jobs. Remove only exact AP wiring to delegate pure legacy AEC3 selection, without changing webrtc_aec3_ci.py. Initial mixed AEC3+AP introduction must select both engineering jobs; all D1-D8 remain false. Existing AEC3 tiny tests may read an exact restored predecessor view, but new tests must cover the full actual workflow, the real 64-path c7 diff plus new AP/F05 additions, both mandatory jobs, and hidden mutation/unknown-path rejection.
workflow.support_only: Exact new F05/AEC3/RIR result files and registered navigation/tiny-test lines may accompany the new scope; metadata alone never triggers audio/engineering. Existing legacy science or DSP edits must refuse rather than fall through.

reviewed_integration.boundary: Only the actual BASE_SHA-to-HEAD changed paths are checked. Every fixed carryover must match its recorded old-to-new SHA transition; unchanged files already merged into a newer main are irrelevant. A later-base rollback to a registered older quality.yml is rejected. No open-ended prefix or workflow allowlist.

required_selection_examples.change: actual 64-path c7 integration plus new AP and F05 validation method/wiring
new AP/F05 validation method after existing AEC3 method is unchanged on base
unknown old science, source DSP, unrelated workflow, or changed supposedly fixed carryover

reviewed_transport.boundary: Fallback exact transition registry only if these already-reviewed changes remain in the actual PR diff before #972 merges. Prefer protected merge #972 first; no transport-only change triggers AP/AEC3.

workflow.selection_base: Use actual GitHub BASE_SHA for changed paths and old bytes; immutable c7 and 38e1a85d registries are evidence, not a replacement comparison base.

reviewed_transport_followup.boundary: Only exact 38e1a85d-to-c3894ed2 transitions, or their documented 4eec-to-38e1a85d-to-c3894ed2 composition, are admitted. The actual Actions BASE_SHA still supplies old bytes; no reverse transition or generic quality edit is allowed. APT source selection changes no audio or experiment budget.

workflow.predecessor_identity_authority: The module pins public 819849ee and SHA99b75e18 independently of this plan, and compares restored complete bytes to that actual Git blob. Editing this plan and old jobs together must fail.

reviewed_ref_retention.boundary: Only the two published source-custody additions and accompanying exact document, composed with the already-reviewed 4eec-to-F08 retained registry, are allowed. Existing 84 objects, candidate sets, policy and gc_eligible/auto_gc semantics are unchanged. Neither path triggers engineering. Reverse or arbitrary registry changes refuse.

workflow.result_publication_boundary: These five exact previously absent result paths and one exact navigation fragment are reserved before measurement. They are support-only, cannot trigger AP/AEC3 engineering, cannot delete/rewrite existing published paths, and do not permit any other documentation/science changes. Initial base-to-head method introduction still selects both applicable engineering jobs. Actual result contents remain subject to independent measurement/readback; path admission grants no scientific PASS.

failure_policy: Preserve every actual failed prefix and log. No retry, compiler fallback, parameter/lag search or false success manifest. Late identity, budget or packaging failure changes the admissible status to FAIL and renames already-created tar/manifest/receipt to explicit before-failure names without discarding their bytes. Upload both original failed archives and reports. The 600s process alarm and 60s engineering alarm include source admission/readback; the outer 630s timeout is cleanup-only grace.

render_correlation.purpose: Precompile the unchanged canonical validation-only correlation C helper in Actions so reserved-validation secondary scoring and independent readback never auto-compile locally. No product DSP or metric definition changes.
render_correlation.compiler: Same actually recorded GNU compiler as AP; preserve exact command, stdout/stderr, ELF, dependencies and original loader/compiler identity.
render_correlation.canonical_score: Call the unmodified exact_score and original engine.normalized_corr(stride=4); retain its 1e-10 native/canonical agreement requirement. The bounded Python oracle is restricted to four synthetic helper checks, never real data or scientific search.
render_correlation.loader_policy: Under the original non-reentrant _NATIVE_LOCK, accept only initial None/_NATIVE_TEMP=None or this binder-owned identical state/CDLL/function/path/SHA. Reject any automatic compilation, cleared/replaced state or compiler fallback before exact_score.
render_correlation.parent_process: Require fresh Linux Python with no LD_PRELOAD/LD_AUDIT/LD_LIBRARY_PATH at exec-time (/proc/self/environ) or now; never pop variables to claim a clean parent. Compare the actually mapped library/dependency path, inode, device and SHA to ldd identities.
render_correlation.independent_reader: verify_bundle/verify_engineering remain no-execution byte/math readback. Explicit bind+guarded max_abs_corr may load the preserved .so for canonical scoring with no C compiler, SDK processor or decoder calls; report the reader math host separately from original measurement host.
